meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline_en: Query and cross-analyze multiple bioinformatics databases through one unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bio databases in one consistent workflow

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Python 的 bioservices 包调用约 40 个生物信息学网络服务,检索蛋白、通路、化合物等信息,并在不同数据库之间转换编号。
howto.when: 当你要跨数据库查询(如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等)、做 ID 映射或序列相似性搜索时接管;单个数据库的快速查询原文建议改用 gget。

howto.what_en: Installs a Python package that queries about 40 bioinformatics web services: it fetches protein, pathway and compound data and converts identifiers across databases, producing code and results in the session.
howto.when_en: Use when a workflow needs cross-database queries or ID mapping across services like UniProt, KEGG or ChEMBL; the doc points single-database lookups to gget and sequence/file edits to biopython.
